div.head: Af El. 43
div.ab: Dem ðu swiþe ryhtne dom; ⁊ ne dem þu oðerne dom ðam welegan, oþerne ðam earman; ne oðerne ðam leofan ond oþerne ðam laðan ne dæm ðu.
Dem ðu swiðe emne. Ne dem ðu oðerne dóm þam welegan, oðerne ðam earman; ne oðerne þam liofran ⁊ oðerne þam laðran ne dem ðu.
Dem ðu swiðe emne. Ne dem ðu oðerne dom þam welegan, oðerne ðam earman; ne oðerne þam liofran ⁊ oðerne þam laðran ne dem ðu.
Judge very evenly. Do not give one judgment to the rich man and another to the poor; nor one for a friend and another for an enemy.
Judge thou very fairly. Do not judge one judgment for the rich and another for the poor; nor one for the one more dear and another for the one more hateful.
Richte du höchst (gerecht und höchst) gleichmässig: nicht sprich du anderes Urtheil dem Reichen, anderes dem Armen; noch ertheile du anderes dem [dir] lieberen und anderes dem [dir] leidigeren.
Judge most (justly and most) evenly: do not pronounce one judgment for the rich man and another for the poor; nor give one to the one dearer [to you] and another to the one more hateful [to you].
